notes: This book is built around six animals (black cat, brown horse, pink pig, yellow dog, green duck, red cow) following a child on a walk. All six animal names and their associated colours are the core fringe vocabulary. Note: 'red' (for the red cow) is intentionally omitted from fringe_11 as it is already present in the existing activity_images vocab ('red cow') and 'red' as a standalone colour is available in core row 5 via the 'colour' prompt. The 11 fringe slots are fully occupied by the six animals and five of their colours — the most communicatively useful set for retelling and interacting with this highly repetitive, pattern-based book. The existing aac_extras (walk, see, following) complement this board well and can be referenced during shared reading.
